title: escort orchestrator: deferred-promote flow with twin-shadow validation
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Add Escort Orchestrator to enable deferred promotion from shadow to canary with twin-shadow validation; new rollout API flags; improved telemetry and safety gates.
commits: a1b2c3d: initial escort orchestrator skeleton and API proto
b2c3d4e: implement twin-shadow validation pipeline and metrics
c3d4e5f: add DB migration for escort run state and index
d4e5f6g: add CLI promote command with --deferred flag
f6g7h8i: fix race in kv cache shard indexing reported in review
description:
Context and motivation: We frequently run into cases where running a shadow validation pass (for quality and correctness) is not sufficient to immediately promote a model into canary traffic due to session affinity and lifecycle coupling (customers with stateful session stickiness or complex routing can't transition atomically). The Escort Orchestrator introduces a deferred-promote flow that decouples validation from promotion and provides a short-lived ‘escort’ lane that mirrors twin-shadow traffic while holding promotion in a quarantined lease until safety gates pass. This enables safer promotion for stateful and session-affine deployments without blocking other rollouts.

What this PR does (single-string body): Adds a new Escort Orchestrator controller that manages deferred promotions and twin-shadow validation, API and CLI surface for deferred promote, DB migration for escort run state, new telemetry for escort lifecycle, and e2e + load tests. Includes docs and an example manifest.

Key behavior and user-visible changes: - New Rollout API fields: escort { enabled: bool, hold_ttl_seconds: int, twin_shadow_ratio: float } and promote { deferred: bool } - CLI: rolloutctl promote --deferred applies a deferred promote which creates an escort run instead of an immediate canary swap - Escort run lifecycle: create -> mirror twin-shadow -> evaluate gates -> if gates pass within TTL then promote canary atomically; if gates fail or TTL expires, auto-revert and emit detailed telemetry - Safety gates evaluated: latency P95, error-rate delta, quality regression (scored via eval hook), and stability delta compared to baseline - Rollout state stored in new escort_runs table; runs are lease-backed and resumable after controller restarts

High-level implementation notes: - services/rollout/controller/escort_orchestrator.go: core state machine with optimistic lease updating and backoff for promote attempts - api/proto/v1/rollouts.proto: added EscortRun message and new flags; backwards-compatible changes with default values - migrations/20260213_add_escort_table.sql: escort_runs table and indexes to support efficient queries by rollout_id and created_at - pkg/safety/gates.go: extracted shared gate evaluation helpers and added twin-shadow comparator - internal/telemetry/metrics_rollouts.go: new metrics (escort_run_created, escort_run_promote_attempts, escort_run_reverts, escort_gate_violation_count) and labels for cohort and session_affinity_hint - pkg/kvcache/kv_cache_shard.go: minor change to shard indexing to avoid a race when promoting model versions during escort run rebinds - tests/e2e/escort_promote_smoke_test.go + scripts/load-tests: coverage for common error and success paths

Files changed summary (human): - Controller and state machine (majority of delta) - API proto and CLI plumbing - DB migration and model to persist escort run state - Observability (metrics, dashboard) - Examples, docs, e2e + load tests

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked and reviewed (ENG-4729) - [x] API proto backwards compatibility checked - [x] DB migration tested locally and idempotent - [x] Metrics and dashboard added - [x] e2e smoke + load tests included - [x] Docs and example manifest updated

Testing and CI: Initial CI run failed one flaky test (tests/e2e/replica_failover_test) due to unrelated test ordering; reran and all checks passed. Unit tests: 118 passed, 2 skipped. Integration: escort_promote_smoke_test (passing). Load test harness run locally against staging cluster at ~2k RPS to validate mirror load.

Review conversation (condensed): Oliver Chen (reviewer): "Very clear state machine. A few asks: 1) add a stricter TTL bound at controller side to avoid stuck runs, 2) surface gate failure reason in rollout API for operators." -- Author reply (Priya): "Added controller-side max_hold_window and included gate failure reasons in the run status (see escort_orchestrator.go and proto)." Marcus Feldman (reviewer): "Consider a limit on concurrent escort runs per cluster to avoid resource amplification." -- Author: "Added concurrent_run_limit to rollout config and enforced in controller startup path." Emily Zhang (approver): "LGTM after kv cache race fix" -- Author: "fixed in commit f6g7h8i and added unit test to reproduce previous race."

Operational considerations: - Default behavior is opt-in (escort.enabled = false) so existing rollouts unaffected - Added a cluster-wide config to cap concurrent escort runs (sane default 20) - Added dashboard with drilldowns for per-rollout runs and gate violation traces - Alerting: new alert rule for escort_run_revert_rate > 1% over 10m which surfaces regressions early

Backward compatibility and migration: API changes are additive. DB migration creates a new table and uses migration tooling; rollouts without escort fields will behave as before. Migration gate run was executed on staging; no data loss expected.

Merge outcome and post-merge actions: - PR merged by squash-and-merge. Merge commit: 9f8e7d6 - Post-merge: trigger migration job during next maintenance window (ops runbook updated). Ops checklist in docs/rollouts/escort-orchestrator.md includes rollback playbook if migration needs to be reverted.

Related work: linear ENG-4729 design thread; SUP-8842 incident follow-up where deferred promotion would have prevented a mid-promote outage.

Notes for followup PRs: - Add UI controls in Console for inspecting escort runs and manually overriding failed gates - Add a policy-driven auto-escalation that can escalate to human review instead of auto-revert - Tighten default gate thresholds after 2 weeks of telemetry

This description string intentionally includes full review thread, CI notes, and operational guidance in a single continuous blob to match PR page formatting.
